scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.pack: electron-vite build && bun ../../scripts/prepare-bundle.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --dir
scripts.dist:linux: electron-vite build && bun ../../scripts/prepare-bundle.ts --target linux-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --linux
scripts.dist:mac: electron-vite build && bun ../../scripts/prepare-bundle.ts --target mac-arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --mac
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && bun ../../scripts/prepare-bundle.ts --target win-x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win
